theatres.title: Clayface

theatres.fullReview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
theatres.take: Critics are split — praise for the direction and humour, pushback on the pacing.
theatres.takeCounter: Audiences disagree — viewers rate it far higher.

fcScore.reason: Audiences love it; critics are split.

theatres.fullReview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. theatres.take: Truly divisive — for every critic who bought in, one checked out.
